@base-ui/react: Stays, because this dashboard runs shadcn on the base-nova preset. shadcn is not tied to Base UI: components.json carries a base field of radix or base, and the shadcn package itself depends on neither -- the primitive library arrives with the components the CLI writes. Having chosen base, src/components/ui/{badge,button,separator}.tsx import it directly and removing it breaks them; card.tsx and table.tsx need no primitive at all. Switching to radix is a preset change, not a package edit. D32 first grouped it with react-aria-components as a package to remove, which was wrong.
card mapper: Restricted to identity, a bundled function, or a declarative spec, so mapping is never arbitrary agent-authored code. Named for what it maps to, because what it maps from is any structured data rather than only an API.
card template: Defined in application source, hand-written or assembled by the service from a declarative composition tree (D22, narrows D2) -- the agent never authors component code directly either way. Correctness comes from tsc against the declared library's real types, not a hand-maintained parallel schema (an earlier draft tried that and was wrong). Static trees only -- a widget needing hooks or local state stays hand-written. None ship today: the original five were deleted in D32.
component library: Declared once, at dashboard initialization (D23), not through a mutation — the same reasoning as D22 applied to styling instead of structure. Letting a mutation or a card template introduce CSS ad hoc would mean re-deriving what's in bounds per call; naming one library once keeps every later styling choice checkable against a fixed, known vocabulary instead of arbitrary CSS. shadcn/ui today.
database: Omitted; the dataset is too small to need one, and a local JSON file stays directly usable as context for local AI tools.
decision records: No ADR directory. Pre-release decisions churn, and a superseded record left on disk misleads agents that grep for it. Current-state documents are edited in place instead, and reasons live here keyed by term.
display-role key: Schema keys name how a value is displayed rather than what it means in a source domain, so a card mapper can retarget new source data onto an existing template without new code.
react-aria-components: Stale (D25): its use predates shadcn/ui becoming the framework, and card templates now compose shadcn components directly rather than a headless layer beneath them. Still declared only because the composition-tree assembler (D22) generates and typechecks against it; it leaves once that is reworked onto the registry-item output D32 calls for.
registry: A running dashboard serves its own wired-in card templates as a shadcn-compatible registry (D24), generated at request time from includedCardTemplates rather than a directory scan — the templates directory also holds a view component, tests, and in-flight assemble output that a scan would wrongly surface as items.
templates directory: Example source data shapes live at templates/ with placeholder content. The shape is what card templates are validated against; the content is never real.
